perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, the available information is:

- RECOMMENDER greeted SEEKER and asked what kind of movie they were looking for.
- SEEKER said they wanted a film of any genre with a woman in the lead and was in the mood for a good heroine.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *The Blind Side* (2009) with Sandra Bullock. SEEKER said they had not seen it and asked if it was about her adopting a Black kid. RECOMMENDER confirmed and said it was really good.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *The Help* (2011) with Emma Stone and Viola Davis. SEEKER responded: “I’ll rent it tonight....I did see that. It made me cry and laugh throughout.”
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Precious*, about a girl whose mother is mean to her. SEEKER said they tried to watch it but couldn’t because it was too sad; it brought back memories of being overweight in their early 20s. RECOMMENDER said it was awful and that the girl had to deal with so much.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* (2011), another Sandra Bullock film. RECOMMENDER was not sure if it was based on the novel of the same name, and said it was about an autistic boy who loses his father on 9/11. SEEKER confirmed that was the one, said they had read and loved the book but had never seen the movie, and had cried through the entire book. RECOMMENDER said it was very sad but very good, and would read the book.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Breakfast at Tiffany’s* (1961). SEEKER said they had seen it, loved it, and watched it. RECOMMENDER said she loved Audrey and that Audrey was beautiful and elegant; SEEKER agreed.
- RECOMMENDER asked if SEEKER wanted more recommendations. SEEKER has not responded to that in the given dialogue.
